title: How Researchers Use and Verify AI Coding Assistants: Tasks and Validation Practices in Scientific Programming
abstract: arXiv:2609.22049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI has entered research programming, yet there is little evidence about which tasks researchers hand to it or how they decide whether its code is correct. We draw on 527 free-text responses to a 2025 survey of researchers who write code, most of them at U.S. universities. In each response, a researcher recounts a single task from their own work, the way they used an AI tool for it, and what they did to assess the result. We coded the task and the evaluation strategies reported, and related both to programming experience, research area, and confidence ratings. Use was concentrated in five tasks: data handling, visualization, debugging, mathematical/scientific computing, and statistical analysis. Evaluation was informal and individual. translated_title: 研究人员如何使用与验证AI编程助手：科学编程中的任务与验证实践
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能已经进入科研编程领域，但关于研究人员会将哪些任务交给它，以及他们如何判断其代码是否正确，目前几乎没有实证证据。我们分析了2025年一项针对编写代码的研究人员调查中的527份自由文本回答，其中大多数受访者来自美国高校。在每份回答中，研究人员讲述其自身工作中的某一具体任务、使用AI工具的方式，以及他们为评估结果所采取的措施。我们对所报告的任务和评估策略进行了编码，并将其与编程经验、研究领域和信心评分相关联。使用集中在五类任务上：数据处理、可视化、调试、数学/科学计算以及统计分析。评估方式是非正式且个体化的。超过一半的叙述描述了运行生成的代码，而自动化测试和他人审查则较为罕见。用例和评估策略随编程经验的变化很小。
tldr: 该研究基于527份调查回答的编码分析，首次系统揭示了科研人员主要将AI编程助手用于数据处理、可视化、调试、科学计算和统计分析五类任务，但其验证方式以个人运行代码为主，自动化测试和同行审查严重缺失，且验证实践几乎不随编程经验而变化。
en_tdlr: Drawing on 527 coded survey responses, this study reveals that researchers mainly delegate data handling, visualization, debugging, scientific computing, and statistical analysis to AI coding assistants, yet verify results mostly by informally running the code themselves, with automated tests and peer review remaining rare regardless of programming experience.
